Treatment summary
Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which their vehicle was struck while turning left. Complaints
centered on low back pain and muscle tightness consistent with a lumbar strain. The mechanism of injury described
is plausible for a collision of this type. Over the course of ten visits, care consisted of manual therapy, targeted
stretching and strengthening exercises, and graduated activity instruction. Recovery was somewhat slower than
typically expected for a strain of this kind, and the patient remained symptomatic for a longer period than the usual
course would predict. On examination, paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced lumbar range of motion were
noted and support the reported injury. Neurological screening, straight leg raise, and reflex testing were within normal
limits. The patient reports no prior inujry or treatment involving the lumbar region. Billing records reflect single charges
for each service rendered, with no duplicated entries. Continued home exercise and gradual return to normal
activities are recommended, with reassessment if symptoms persist.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- objective_support: Do objective tests (imaging, exam findings) support the complaints? Allowed: Strong, Partial, Predominantly subjective, Contradicted.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- duplicate_billing: Was the same service, visit or part billed twice? Allowed: None, Possible, Confirmed.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
